title: How to send BG (from AAPS) through bluetooth ?
symptom: The user wants to send their BG value from AAPS to a flying computer (Android tablet) via Bluetooth to monitor sugar level in flight.
fix: AAPS by itself does not transmit data anywhere except to a watch if configured. The recommended solution is to use xDrip to receive the G6 data and then use xDrip Follower on the tablet, or use a watch that displays the data. Alternatively, BYODA can broadcast to both AAPS and XDrip++.
evidence_quote: AAPS by itself doesn't transmit data anywhere, except to your watch if you have it configured.
